name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Adam Bielan
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Adam Bielan, a Polish member of the European Parliament. A Polish court asked for this because two people and a company are suing him over statements he made in a radio interview in March 2023, which they say damaged their reputation. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work, so it let the case go ahead.

- **What changes:** Bielan loses his protection from this defamation case in Poland.
- **Who it affects:** Adam Bielan, and the two people and company suing him.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Polish court, and the case can proceed.
